prose: One of the biggest mysteries of the occult is the tarot, especially the fact that there is no "official" version. Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies and Dylan Saccoccio of the Spirit Whirled series join us tonight to decode the Sola Busca deck, one of the most ancient, and strangest, of all arcana. This is likely to be too big for one show, so if you enjoy it and want more, let us know!
